messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a maintenance window for edge GPU pool (edge-west1) on Thu 2026-03-25 03:00-05:00 UTC. Goal: apply NVLink microcode patch + graceful KV-cache reseed/prime. Expect ~5-10% effective capacity reduction while cohorts are drained. @sre-oncall @product FYI :calendar:
chris: Ack. How many nodes at once? any canary plan?
tao: Sequence we propose:
- cordon 4 nodes
- drain with --grace-period=300 (allow long-running inferences to finish)
- restart BMC + apply nvlink microcode
- run kv-cache prime job (see snippet)
- uncordon and wait 10m metrics stabilization
We throttle to 4 nodes concurrently to keep tail-latency under SLO.
Snippet:```bash
for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l pool=edge-west1 -o name | head -n 4); do
  kubectl cordon $n
  kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
  ssh $n sudo /opt/ops/apply-nvlink-fw && sudo reboot
  # after node back, run prime job
  kubectl --namespace ops run kv-prime-$n --image=redwood/kv-seed:stable --restart=Never -- /bin/prime.sh --target=$n
  kubectl uncordon $n
  sleep 600
done
```
nina: Cost/backfill questions — if we lose ~6% capacity for 2h will we hit pay-for-burst? estimate impact?
maria: Quick estimate: concurrent 4-node drain * avg node GPU-hours ~8 GPU-hours total across window. We'll backfill from saturn-burst pool (spot) up to 20 GPUs if needed. Expected incremental infra spend ~ $1.1k-1.5k for the event (spots + short reserved shift), plus some token unit upsell risk for busiest routes.
sre-oncall: We're currently clear on active incidents, but network team flagged higher UDP packet drops in edge-west1 earlier. Can we delay 2 hours to verify stability?
chris: Delay OK for +2h (start 05:00-07:00 UTC) — keeps it outside our morning traffic peak. Everyone ok? :+1:
maria: Shifted to 05:00-07:00 UTC. Updated runbook and comms. Key mitigations:
- reduce concurrency to 3 nodes if latency spikes > 99.9p threshold
- fallback routing: route traffic to eu-west1/dedicated pools for top 5 tenants (automatic via smart-routing)
- KV prime job will checkpoint progress to s3://ops-kv-prime/ so resume is safe
Checklist (pre-run):
- [ ] run canary on 1 node 24h prior
- [ ] notify top tenants + support playbook
- [ ] reserve saturn-burst capacity + confirm billing limits
- [ ] update dashboard alert for kv-cache hit-rate regression
engbot: Maintenance event created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/maintenance/1719991234 — invites sent to @sre-oncall, @platform, @product
maria: OK thanks — tagging owners: tao (runbook), chris (routing failover), nina (cost ops). If no objections, I'll publish tenant comms 24h before window. :white_check_mark:
